paper.title: Wind Farm Layout Optimization with Multi-Type Wind Turbines for Minimizing Levelized Cost of Energy
paper.authors: Tian Li and Baoshan Yang and Qingshan Yang and Mingming Zhang and Weicheng Hu and Kunpeng Guo

public_asset_candidate_evidence.status: target final article and first-party method patent found; no target code or numeric archive found; pinned public NREL turbine data completion

paper_source_conflicts: The journal problem uses a 5 km square with 5 MW and 15 MW turbines, whereas the earlier patent example uses a 2 km square with 2 MW and 5 MW turbines; journal problem semantics take precedence.
The journal describes a multi-objective framework but Eq.39 defines and the GA minimizes one scalar LCOE; power and fatigue are retained as diagnostics rather than independent optimized objectives.
The journal supplies no numeric GA population, crossover, mutation, generation limit, convergence tolerance, seeds or repeat count; the first-party patent supplies the first three settings only.
The target turbine power and thrust curves are figures rather than machine-readable arrays.
missing_information: target author source and random state
target ADMR/RSM CFD fields and fitted raw arrays
machine-readable target power and thrust curves
journal crossover operator, numeric generation limit and convergence tolerance
journal seeds, repeat count and full result archive
completion_decisions: Register twelve unique roles after deduplicating the shared west, fatigue-0.10 and cost-one-third multi-type role.
Use the journal's 5 km, 10 by 10, 5/15-MW problem and use the patent only for omitted GA settings.
Use patent population 100, roulette selection, crossover 0.08, total mutation 0.01 and category-balanced mutation equations.
Use declared single-point categorical crossover and a fixed 1000-generation formal budget without an invented early-stop tolerance.
Use one deterministic run per unique role because no repeat protocol is published.
Use pinned public FLORIS-v2.4 NREL-5-MW and public Cazzaro NREL/IEA-15-240 curve data.
Evaluate published corrected Qian-Ishihara equations at turbine hubs and expose the full/partial-overlap specialization as a declared completion.
Use one persistent full-core C++ team for offspring construction and population evaluation with frozen generations and counter-keyed random events.

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reproduction of the complete multi-type problem, ternary GA and twelve unique native cases; not author source, unavailable CFD arrays, exact plotted curves, random state or numerical replay

decision_variables.resolution: 100 categorical genes: zero empty, one 5 MW, two 15 MW

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: 10 by 10 matrix maps directly to 500m cell-center positions and turbine types

constraints_and_repair.resolution: square boundary, at most one turbine per cell and composition-specific allowed categories; one occupied cell is enforced

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize scalar construction-plus-maintenance cost divided by total steady power

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: corrected three-dimensional Qian-Ishihara hub-point wake/turbulence, type-specific power and thrust, fatigue, preventive/replacement maintenance and multi-type Mosetti construction cost

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: steady 12m/s at 150m with exponent0.12 and Iref0.12; literal west0 northwest45 and southwest-45 roles

paper_native_cases.resolution: twelve unique composition, direction, additional fatigue-threshold and additional cost-ratio cases

initialization.resolution: counter-keyed random categorical matrices with composition restrictions and nonempty repair

parameters.resolution: population100, crossover0.08, total mutation0.01, roulette, category-balanced mutation and declared single-point crossover

update_order.resolution: evaluate frozen population, roulette, crossover, category-balanced mutation, evaluate complete next population and ordered replacement

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: fixed 1000 generations; one complete layout evaluation is one physical FES

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: layout, turbine counts, power, construction/maintenance costs, LCOE, fatigue dispersion, FES, generation, timings, workers and hash; one run per unique role

development_h6_20260731.work: all twelve roles, population 100, fixed 50 generations and 5100 complete layout evaluations per role
development_h6_20260731.comparison_boundary: same pure-C++ implementation with one versus twenty Spark workers; not MATLAB, author-code or Waffle confirmation

development_paper_parameter_preview_2026.claim_boundary: local functional preview with public substitute curves and declared completions; qualitative dual-baseline benefit recovered but not author numeric replay or immutable Waffle formal evidence
